name: Thermal off-gas draft fan

design.materialOfConstruction: T-702 in 316L; FN-701/PSV wetted metal in 316L or Alloy 601/602 CA where temperature/deposit duty persists

reviewFindings: Draft +2 psig conflicts with slight negative pressure. Draft oxygen <10 ppm is an unqualified source claim, not an approved alarm, trip or operating limit. No pressure sign, oxygen threshold or permissive is selected.

Draft approximately 1100 degC, 4 h hold and 5 degC/min ramp are indicative only. Gas cooling 60-90 degC and product cooling 60-80 degC require qualification. Capacities, materials, gas composition and argon demand are unknown.

Draft considers KO/dust trap upstream of E-701; model KO-701 is downstream. Draft internal cooling zone differs from model-added E-702. Draft prior-to-cyclone note has no identified drawn/model cyclone; no cyclone is invented.

Normal gas connects to AB-3701 candidate only; treatment performance and permitted discharge remain unqualified. Model RV-701 differs from draft PSV-701. Relief destination, sizing and backpressure remain open and separate from normal treatment.

Draft is Not for Use with XXX revision. AR701/AR702 are draft stream identifiers, not confirmed equipment aliases for model AR-701. Air-fill dust vent and inert purge exhaust are distinct modes; purge, equalization, sampling and solids release sequences remain unqualified.
